Name: Richie - New Custom NPC
Author: MrMrRogers
Description:
Warning, this mod contains references to alcoholism.

Please note, this is my first time creating any kind of mod - if there are any issues please let me know.

Meet Richie!! Harvey's nephew is staying in his spare room for the time being while trying to figure out what to do with his life. Maybe you'll be able to help him find his place.

Richie has a lot of energy and can be found all over town, spending his days in a variety of places - such as the beach, Pierre's shop, Pam's trailer, the hospital, the museum, around town, or in a new custom location.

The custom location is an area of land below the bus stop that is blocked by a fence until after seeing Richie's 6 heart event.

There are a total of 8 new events as well as adding Richie to existing events and festivals and a large selection of dialogue lines.

Config guide:
- Music: Can enable or disable custom music for Richie. Additional mod is no longer needed for this.
- Enthusiasm: Replaces all !! with !
- RemoveFarmland: Disables the custom area beneath the bus stop. This also means Richie's 6 and 8 heart events will not occur and some dialogue may be changed. Custom items (seeds, plant, and tea) will also not be created.
- HeartOfTheValley: Allows the Heart Of The Valley seeds to be planted outside of the custom farmland, by default this is not the case.
- Lofts: Moves Richie into the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30295]Pelican Valley Lofts[/url]. The event in Harvey's Room and the second part of Richie's 14 heart event will no longer occur and some dialogue may be changed.

Events Guide:
[spoiler]
2 Heart: Beach between 9am and 1pm. Not in winter.
4 Heart: Pierre's Store between 9am and 12.
6 Heart: Custom area between 12 and 7pm. Not in winter.
8 Heart: Museum between 9am and 1pm. Not in winter.
10 Heart: Town between 6am and 12. Not in winter.
14 Heart p1: Farmhouse not in winter.
14 Heart p2: Hospital between 9am and 12. Not in winter.
14 Heart p3: Harvey's Room on a Sunday between 9am and 12. Not in winter.

Winter Event: Saloon on Winter 21 between 7pm and 2am. Must have seen 4 heart event. WARNING: involves relapse and drinking.
Married to Harvey Event: Harvey's Room between 7pm and 10pm.[/spoiler]
